sentences.quote: Mr. Lee Yuan Siong, aged 60, is an Executive Director and the Group Chief Executive and President of the Company, having been appointed on 1 June 2020. Mr. Lee is also a member of the Risk Committee and the Technology, Operations and Data Committee of the Company. He joined the Group in March 2020 and has more than 30 years of experience in the insurance sector.
sentences.text: Lee Yuan Siong has been Executive Director and Group Chief Executive and President of AIA Group Limited since 1 June 2020, having joined the Group in March 2020 with more than 30 years of experience in the insurance sector; he also sits on the company's Risk Committee and its Technology, Operations and Data Committee.

Born in Singapore in 1965, he was co-CEO, executive director and group chief insurance business officer of Ping An Insurance (Group) Company of China, and earlier chairman and CEO of Ping An Life, following senior roles at Prudential plc and the start of his career at the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

He holds a master's degree in finance from the University of Cambridge and a bachelor's degree in actuarial science from the London School of Economics, and is a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (US).

citations.title: AIA appoints group chief risk officer

sentences.quote: Ng will assume the role of group chief risk officer from January 1 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
sentences.text: Ben Ng became Group Chief Risk Officer and a Group Executive Committee member on 1 January 2026, succeeding Jayne Plunkett, who retired from the role after holding it since 2019.
In February 2026 AIA appointed Shulamite N K Khoo and Ku Man (David Ku) as independent non-executive directors, effective 5 February 2026.
Lee Yuan Siong joined the Technology, Operations and Data Committee on 1 April 2026 and ceased to be chairman, director and chief executive officer of subsidiary AIA Co. in May and June 2026.
Announcing record 2025 results in March 2026, Lee said the group's strategy continues to evolve with customer needs, technological progress and market opportunities.
